comments:
Contains only the last section - 4) bzhi bcu drug gi dam bsal bar bston pa'i ti ka 'thad ldan - starting with "bslab pa de phun sum ‘tshogs pa nyid du bsgrub par byed pa lhag ma bzhi’ bcu’ drug gis brjod pa la" down to the conclusive verses and final colophon of the 'Thad ldan.

Manuscript from sPo mi spyan drug provided by bKra shis dbang rgyal ([S635TW6P]: 106 "spo mi spyan drug lung bkra shis dbang rgyal nas ma dpe mkha' don gnang pa 'dul Tik 'thad ldan zhes bya ba'i gzhi smad la ldeb 44").

item_description:
The folio numbers are not visible on the reproduction.
Lines per folio: 8.
Long marginal annotations.
On fol. 31b, annotation in dbu can in the margin: spo bas te med par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i - possibly a writing exercise.
The last two lines of the colophon are hardly legible due to fading.
